items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 37:1
items.html: AA clothes upon the seven lower [Sefirot] of Atik, which stand in the place of the seven lower [Sefirot] of Nekudim, which are the ZA of Nekudim; hence AA stands in the place of ZA. Therefore the place of AA must be the place of ZA. (Item 81).
